cover_letter:
Dear LTM Hiring Team,

With over 8 years of professional experience as a Product Owner and Digital Product Manager, and based in Curitiba, Brazil, I am excited to apply for the Product Owner role at LTM.

My core expertise lies in end-to-end product backlog management, writing clear user stories with strict acceptance criteria, and facilitating Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Reviews, and Dailies). I work as the right hand to Product Managers and the primary daily contact for engineering and QA teams to resolve ambiguities and ensure smooth delivery.

I bring fluent English skills for daily communication, a technical foundation in Engineering (UTFPR/UFPR 2.5 yrs) combined with Philosophy (UFPR), and proven autonomy in distributed teams. Being located in Curitiba, I have full availability for occasional in-person meetings.

Sincerely,
Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: How do you manage product backlog refinement and user stories?
form_answers.answer: I partner closely with Product Managers to translate roadmaps into actionable backlogs. I write clear user stories with explicit acceptance criteria, conduct refinement ceremonies with engineering/QA to remove ambiguities, and prioritize items based on business value and technical feasibility.
